records.title: Large Model in Low-Altitude Economy: Applications and Challenges
records.reason: Publisher title identifies large-model applications/challenges in low-altitude economy, not inference optimization.

records.title: Attention mechanisms in neural networks
records.reason: This paper provides a mathematical treatment of attention mechanisms rather than a new inference optimization; it contains no evaluated serving or system-level efficiency result.

records.title: Masking Teacher and Reinforcing Student for Distilling Vision-Language Models
records.reason: Masking Teacher and Reinforcing Student is a vision-language-model distillation/training method. Its contribution is training quality, not inference efficiency.

records.title: HTTM: Head-wise Temporal Token Merging for Faster VGGT
records.reason: HTTM merges temporal visual tokens for VGGT; on 1,000 frames it reports about 7x lower latency than VGGT and 4.58x less merging cost. It is a 3D-vision transformer rather than an LLM, but temporal token merging may inform adjacent long-sequence systems.

records.title: Demystifying Diffusion Objectives: Reweighted Losses are Better Variational Bounds
records.reason: The paper analyzes diffusion training objectives and variational bounds; its contribution is mathematical/training-side and has no inference acceleration result.
